project.title: Eclipse Phase 2e Character & Morph Creator
project.summary: A local-first web tool for creating, validating, saving, resleeving, and printing Eclipse Phase Second Edition characters.

items.title: Complete the first supported creation workflow
items.notes: Core aptitude templates, nine core backgrounds with restricted combat-skill choices, all 14 core careers and matching gear packs, all core faction choices including six regional affiliations, all 15 non-Psi interest packages, including independent Pilot fields, skill totals and transfers, custom Active fields, starting motivations and goals, campaign gear packs, and shared CP spending on aptitudes, skills, ego Flex, languages, reputation, and specializations are implemented. Career gear includes Covert Operative and Soldier synthmorph alternatives, errata corrections, and the Genehacker payload cost qualifier. Supported ego traits apply costs and capped bonuses, Expert Training raises one skill cap, and each aptitude check has a supported positive and negative trait with traced per-level modifiers. Skill bases continue to use the underlying aptitude scores. Contact and Morph Familiarity support separate scoped purchases with duplicate checks and one CP per entry. Hardening supports three non-Psi stress immunities with cumulative WIL Check and Persuade Test penalties, separate skill ratings and test targets, and specialization handling. Initiative, Lucidity, Trauma Threshold, and Insanity Rating have live calculation traces, normal rounding, and signed Composure and Instability modifiers. Instability grants 2 or 4 CP under the shared negative trait cap. Fixed-cost gear can be swapped for equal-GP items from supported packs, with source and restriction labels. The four core infomorphs can be chosen as sleeves, and an infomorph first sleeve can use the optional 10 GP pack in the campaign slot. The starting Morph Point budget uses a GM allowance, the Resources trait bonus, and verified first-sleeve costs. Unused MP grants temporary Flex until the first resleeve. Add broader trait coverage and exceptions, Psi with the Lost background and Async interest, gear swaps from the Gear chapter, and extra equipment and morph trait purchases against the MP budget.

items.title: Browse, filter, and compare supported morphs
items.notes: Search, category filters, a comparison of up to three profiles, and source links cover the Quick-Start examples and all four core infomorphs. All listed profiles show a sourced MP cost, and the core infomorphs also show their pools. Expand verified player profiles and restrictions and add the planned price, movement, durability, and capability filters.

items.title: Verify keyboard access, mobile layouts, and print
items.notes: Run the planned accessibility audit and test the complete player workflow across supported layouts. The initial Edge PDF and grayscale review is recorded in docs/print-review.md. Verify native print-dialog controls, physical grayscale output, very long notes, and other supported browsers.

items.title: Prepare onboarding and feedback for public beta
items.notes: Document known limitations and cover the planned feedback loop, error monitoring, and privacy-respecting metrics.
